response_text: We used the debugger to observe the Cortex-M4’s live memory while the program was running. In this lab, it allowed us to examine the actual contents of the stack at each step of code execution. This level of visibility is crucial because functions like printf are complex and can significantly alter the stack by the time they execute. As a result, relying on printf to inspect the stack could lead to misleading or overwritten data. By setting breakpoints, we were able to pause execution at precise moments and inspect the immediate memory state.\n
